element_scores.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
element_scores.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Policy and IP Restrictions Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 with detailed AI-READI Data License Agreement; subsets define public vs controlled access; license prohibits clinical treatment decisions, re-identification, sharing with non-licensed parties
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive access policy with dual licensing (public CC BY-NC 4.0 + controlled access DUA). Clear restrictions and use terms documented.

sub_elements.name: Regulatory Restrictions and Confidentiality Level Specified
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements: 3 defined (genetic/biospecimen, geographic/demographic identifiers, medical history/records) with controlled access designation; license prohibits re-identification
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit documentation of sensitive data elements with controlled access requirements. Regulatory compliance through IRB and data use agreements.

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available

sub_elements.quality_note: Direct platform link to FAIRhub repository with clear download mechanisms described for both public and controlled access data.

sub_elements.name: Distribution Formats and File Types Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: 4 defined (DICOM for imaging, CSV for tabular/time-series, mHealth standard for wearable data, XML for ECG); preprocessing_strategies mention format conversions from proprietary to standards
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive format documentation with 4 distinct distribution formats mapped to data types. Includes format conversion details from proprietary sources.

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets and External Resources Linked

sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive external resources (9 distinct) with publications, repositories, documentation, and parent program links. Strong ecosystem integration.

element_scores.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
element_scores.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 permits distribution, remix, adaptation, building upon work non-commercially with proper citation; controlled access via DUA
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear reuse permissions under CC BY-NC 4.0 with explicit allowances for derivative works, remixing, and building upon with attribution requirement.

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized (encoding, format)
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: DICOM (imaging), CSV (tabular), mHealth standard (wearables), XML (ECG); preprocessing_strategies document conversion from proprietary formats (.fda, .sdt, .FIT) to standards
sub_elements.quality_note: All data distributed in standardized formats (DICOM, CSV, mHealth, XML). Proprietary format conversion process documented for reproducibility.

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies mention OMOP Common Data Model for clinical data, DICOM for imaging, mHealth standard for wearables, RxNorm codes for medications, ICD-10 codes for diabetes classification
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit conformance to multiple standards: OMOP CDM (clinical), DICOM (imaging), mHealth (wearables), RxNorm (medications), ICD-10 (diagnoses). Strong semantic interoperability.

sub_elements.name: Variable Metadata with Identifiers Defined
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: 12 detailed methods documenting variables across survey/questionnaire (demographics, CES-D-10, PAID, RxNorm), physical measurements (height, weight, BMI, waist-hip ratio, BP, HR), retinal imaging (8 devices), visual function, clinical labs (CBC, lipids, HbA1c, kidney/liver markers), ECG, MoCA cognitive scores, monofilament testing, CGM (mg/dL every 5 min), activity monitoring (steps, HR, sleep, O2), environmental sensors (11 measurements)
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive variable-level documentation across 12 acquisition methods with specific instruments, measurements, units, and variable names. Rich metadata for each domain.

sub_elements.name: Use Guidance Provided (intended, prohibited uses)
sub_elements.evidence: intended_uses: 5 defined (AI/ML model development for T2DM, multi-modal research, health equity research, biomarker discovery, model dataset for standards); discouraged_uses: 3 defined (uses during ongoing enrollment without awareness, clinical decision-making without validation, re-identification attempts)
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear use guidance with 5 intended uses and 3 discouraged uses. Covers appropriate research contexts and explicitly warns against clinical use and re-identification.

element_scores.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
element_scores.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: University of Washington IRB approval STUDY00016228 with reliance agreements from UAB and UCSD; human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: true; written informed consent from all participants; Community Advisory Board of 11 persons; bioethics guidance integrated
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive IRB documentation with specific approval number (STUDY00016228), multi-site reliance agreements, consent procedures, and community engagement. Strong ethical oversight.

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: subsets distinguish public (de-identified, not sensitive PHI) from controlled access (5-digit zip, detailed demographics, genetic data, health records); license prohibits re-identification attempts
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear deidentification approach with tiered access: public dataset contains de-identified non-sensitive data, controlled dataset contains potentially identifiable elements (5-digit zip, genetics). Re-identification explicitly prohibited.

semantic_validation.deidentification_approach: tiered access with public de-identified subset

sub_elements.name: Privacy Protections Beyond Deidentification
sub_elements.evidence: license prohibits re-identification, sharing with non-licensed parties; Data Access Committee developing controlled access requirements; bioethics guidance throughout study; sensitive_elements documented with access restrictions
sub_elements.quality_note: Multi-layered privacy protections including contractual prohibitions, data access committee oversight, bioethics integration, and explicit sensitive data classification.

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: written informed consent provided by all participants; human_subject_research confirms IRB approval and consent; Community Advisory Board contributed to protocol development
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit documentation of written informed consent from all participants. Community engagement in consent protocol development demonstrates ethical rigor.

sub_elements.name: Vulnerable Populations and Compensation Documented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations document racial/ethnic diversity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White 25% each); triple-balanced sampling designed for equity; bioethics guidance and Community Advisory Board with diversity in race/ethnicity; exclusion criteria include pregnancy (vulnerable population protection)
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit attention to vulnerable and underrepresented populations with balanced sampling, community advisory board, bioethics oversight, and protective exclusion criteria. Compensation not documented but ethical framework strong.

element_scores.name: Data Composition and Structure
element_scores.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Subpopulations Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances: 4,000 participants aged 40+, triple-balanced by race/ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), sex (male, female), T2DM severity (no diabetes, pre-diabetes/lifestyle, medication-controlled, insulin-controlled); subpopulations: 8 defined with target 1,000 participants each; inclusion: age 40+, English proficiency; exclusion: pregnancy, type 1 diabetes
sub_elements.quality_note: Extremely detailed cohort description with specific target (4,000), age criteria, triple-balanced design, 8 subpopulations with equal targets, and clear inclusion/exclusion criteria.

sub_elements.name: Number of Instances or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: instances: target enrollment 4,000 people; updates: pilot data May 2024, v1.0.0 through July 31 2024, v2.0.0 and v3.0.0 released; enrollment began July 18, 2023, continues until November 30, 2026
sub_elements.quality_note: Target sample size clearly stated (4,000 participants). Versioning provides transparency about progressive enrollment with specific release dates and enrollment timeline.

sub_elements.name: Variable-Level Metadata and Tabular Flag
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: 12 detailed methods documenting variables across all domains (survey: demographics, CES-D-10, PAID, dietary, medications with RxNorm; physical: height, weight, BMI, waist-hip ratio, BP, HR; imaging: 8 devices; labs: CBC, lipids, HbA1c, glucose, kidney/liver markers; ECG; MoCA scores with subscores; monofilament 10 locations; CGM 5-min intervals; Garmin: steps, HR, sleep, O2; environmental: 11 measurements); distribution_formats indicate CSV for tabular data
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive variable-level documentation across 12 acquisition methods with specific measurements, instruments, units, intervals, and scores. Tabular data indicated through CSV format.

sub_elements.name: Data Topics or Conditions Represented
sub_elements.evidence: title and description focus on Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; purposes: understanding T2DM salutogenesis, disease trajectories; instances: T2DM severity stratification (no diabetes, pre-diabetes/lifestyle, medication-controlled, insulin-controlled); keywords: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, T2DM, salutogenesis; acquisition_methods cover T2DM-related domains (retinal complications, CGM, metabolic markers)
sub_elements.quality_note: Primary condition (Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus) clearly defined with severity stratification, salutogenesis focus, and T2DM-specific measurements (retinal imaging, CGM, metabolic panels).

sub_elements.name: Data Quality Issues and Anomalies Documented
sub_elements.evidence: sampling_strategies: not representative, volunteer selection bias documented; discouraged_uses: pilot data and periodic updates may not have achieved balanced distribution; preprocessing_strategies: quality control measures (standardized training, equipment calibration, duplicate measurements, practice subjects, data validation in REDCap); cleaning_strategies: pilot enrollment July-November 2023 to ensure coordinator familiarity
sub_elements.quality_note: Quality limitations explicitly documented (volunteer bias, non-representativeness, balance not achieved in early versions). Extensive QC measures documented (training, calibration, validation). Honest about limitations.

element_scores.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.evidence: updates mention v1.0.0 (data through July 31, 2024), v2.0.0 and v3.0.0 releases; version-specific documentation maintained at docs.aireadi.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Semantic versioning used (v1.0.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0) with version-specific documentation. Clear versioning scheme for progressive data releases.

sub_elements.name: Version Access Methods Documented
sub_elements.evidence: updates: version-specific documentation maintained at https://docs.aireadi.org/ for each release; FAIRhub landing page https://fairhub.io/datasets/2 provides access
sub_elements.quality_note: Version-specific documentation URLs provided. FAIRhub platform likely supports version access but explicit version retrieval mechanism not detailed.

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions and Errata Provided
sub_elements.evidence: updates: pilot data May 2024, v1.0.0 data through July 31 2024 released November 2024, v2.0.0 and v3.0.0 released with additional participants; discouraged_uses warns about pilot data limitations and ongoing enrollment affecting balance
sub_elements.quality_note: Update descriptions provided with release dates and scope (additional participants). Limitations of early versions documented. Errata not explicitly mentioned but change transparency present.

sub_elements.quality_note: Update frequency clearly stated (periodic releases during ongoing enrollment) with final release timeline (late 2026 after November 2026 enrollment completion).

sub_elements.name: Provenance and Source Derivation Documented
sub_elements.evidence: No was_derived_from field present; collection_mechanisms document primary data collection from EHR screening, in-person visits, home monitoring, biospecimen collection; no indication this dataset derives from other datasets
sub_elements.quality_note: Provenance partially documented through collection mechanisms (primary data collection from human subjects, EHR screening). However, no was_derived_from field or parent dataset relationships documented. This is a primary dataset, not derived, so full provenance documentation may be less applicable, but source EHR systems and instrument provenance could be more detailed.

element_scores.name: Scientific Motivation and Funding Transparency
element_scores.description: Does the metadata clearly state why the dataset exists and who funded it?

sub_elements.name: Motivation or Purpose for Dataset Creation
sub_elements.evidence: purposes: 3 defined (understanding T2DM salutogenesis, establishing AI/ML data standards, addressing demographic inequities); addressing_gaps: 3 defined (lack of multimodal T2DM datasets, demographic underrepresentation, AI-readiness of medical datasets); description mentions salutogenesis pathway research
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear scientific rationale with 3 purposes and 3 research gaps addressed. Salutogenesis (disease to health pathway) is novel scientific angle. Equity and AI-readiness motivations explicit.

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objectives or Tasks
sub_elements.evidence: tasks: 3 defined (enable multi-domain AI/ML analyses for T2DM, develop unbiased AI/ML models, study T2DM disease trajectories); purposes align with AI/ML research, health equity, biomarker discovery
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific research tasks documented (3 tasks) with clear focus on AI/ML model development, bias mitigation, and disease trajectory analysis. Aligned with purposes.

sub_elements.name: Funding Sources and Mechanisms Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders: NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program; description: grant OT2OD032644 administered by NIH Office of the Director, additional support from P30DK035816, UL1TR003096, Research to Prevent Blindness; total funding in 2022: $5,026,499; opportunity number OTA-21-008
sub_elements.quality_note: Primary funding source (NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI) with specific grant numbers, administering office, additional grants, total funding amount, and opportunity number. Comprehensive funding transparency.

sub_elements.name: Grant IDs or Award Numbers Present
sub_elements.evidence: funders: OT2OD032644, P30DK035816, UL1TR003096; opportunity number OTA-21-008; external_resources: NIH RePORTER link for 1OT2OD032644-01 (10471118)
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple grant numbers present (OT2OD032644, P30DK035816, UL1TR003096) with correct NIH format. RePORTER link validates grant. OT2 prefix indicates Other Transaction Award for OD (Office of Director). Format validation passes.

semantic_validation.grant_type: OT2 (Other Transaction), P30 (Center Core), UL1 (Clinical Translational Science)

sub_elements.name: Creators and Acknowledgements Documented
sub_elements.evidence: creators: 20 defined with names, affiliations, and roles (Contact PI Aaron Lee, PI Cynthia Owsley, 18 Co-Investigators); institutions: University of Washington, UAB, UCSD; funders acknowledge Research to Prevent Blindness and NIH grants
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive creator documentation (20 individuals) with roles, names, and institutional affiliations. PI and Co-I roles clearly designated. Multiple institutions acknowledged.

element_scores.name: Technical Transparency (Data Collection and Processing)
element_scores.description: Can data collection and processing steps be replicated or understood?

sub_elements.name: Collection Mechanisms and Settings Described
sub_elements.evidence: collection_mechanisms: 5 defined (in-person visits lasting 2.5-4 hours, EHR screening with ICD-10 codes, wave-based recruitment, home wearable monitoring for 10 days, biospecimen collection and biobanking); settings: 3 sites (Birmingham AL, San Diego CA, Seattle WA); enrollment: July 18, 2023 to November 30, 2026
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed collection mechanisms (5 methods) with specific sites, visit duration, screening codes, monitoring duration, and enrollment timeline. Sufficient for replication.

sub_elements.name: Data Acquisition Methods Listed
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: 12 detailed methods with specific instruments (REDCap for surveys, 8 retinal imaging devices with manufacturers, Philips Pagewriter TC30 ECG, MoCA Duo iPad app, Dexcom G6 CGM, Garmin VivoSmart 5, custom environmental sensor, clinical lab equipment); measurement details (CGM every 5 min, BP twice 2 min apart, monofilament 10 times per location)
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive acquisition documentation (12 methods) with manufacturer names, device models, measurement frequencies, protocols. Exceptional detail for technical replication.

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing, Cleaning, and Labeling Strategies
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: 5 defined (data standardization/harmonization across sites, image format conversion from proprietary to DICOM/mHealth, biospecimen processing, quality control/validation, data mapping to standards); cleaning_strategies: multi-site harmonization with standardized protocols, REDCap validation, pilot enrollment for quality
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed preprocessing (5 strategies) and cleaning (1 strategy with multiple components) documentation. Format conversions, QC measures, standardization procedures, and standards mapping all documented.

sub_elements.name: Software and Tools Documented
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods mention REDCap (data management), MoCA Duo Application (iPad), specific device software implied (Dexcom G6, Garmin VivoSmart 5, Philips ECG, retinal imaging systems); preprocessing mentions format conversion tools (proprietary to DICOM/mHealth); external_resources link to documentation (docs.aireadi.org)
sub_elements.quality_note: Software documented for data collection (REDCap, MoCA Duo, device software) and processing (format converters to DICOM/mHealth). Documentation portal provided for detailed methods.

sub_elements.name: External Standards and Resources Referenced
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: OMOP CDM, DICOM, mHealth, RxNorm, ICD-10 referenced; external_resources: 9 resources including publications (BMJ Open 10.1136/bmjopen-2024-097449, Nature Metabolism 10.1038/s42255-024-01165-x), documentation (docs.aireadi.org), Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.10642459), NIH RePORTER, Bridge2AI program
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple standards referenced (5 standards) with publication DOIs (2 protocol papers), documentation portal, archived resources, and grant information. Strong external linkage.

element_scores.name: Dataset Evaluation and Limitations Disclosure
element_scores.description: Does the metadata communicate known risks, biases, or dataset limitations?

sub_elements.name: Known Limitations Documented
sub_elements.evidence: sampling_strategies.why_not_representative: triple-balanced design intentionally over-samples racial/ethnic minorities and diabetes severity groups, volunteer selection bias limits generalizability to non-volunteers; discouraged_uses: pilot data may not have achieved balanced distribution, ongoing enrollment limitations
sub_elements.quality_note: Limitations explicitly documented including non-representativeness rationale, volunteer bias, generalizability constraints, and temporal limitations during ongoing enrollment.

sub_elements.name: Systematic Biases Identified and Described
sub_elements.evidence: sampling_strategies: volunteer selection bias documented; why_not_representative: triple-balanced over-sampling creates intentional imbalance relative to population prevalence for equity purposes; discouraged_uses: early data may have sampling imbalance during recruitment waves
sub_elements.quality_note: Volunteer bias explicitly identified. Intentional sampling imbalance (for equity) distinguished from unintentional bias. Wave-based recruitment bias acknowledged for early releases.

sub_elements.name: Data Anomalies and Quality Issues Noted
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies document QC measures (calibration, duplicate measurements, validation, practice subjects) implying awareness of potential quality issues; cleaning_strategies mention pilot enrollment to ensure coordinator familiarity and prevent quality issues; discouraged_uses warn about balance not achieved in early versions
sub_elements.quality_note: Quality issues addressed proactively through QC measures, pilot phase, and warnings about early data. Implicit acknowledgment of potential anomalies through extensive validation procedures.

sub_elements.name: Sensitive Content and Warnings Provided
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements: 3 defined (genetic/biospecimen, geographic/demographic identifiers, medical history/records) with controlled access designation; discouraged_uses: re-identification attempts prohibited, clinical decision-making without validation warned against
sub_elements.quality_note: Sensitive content clearly identified (3 categories) with access controls. Warnings against re-identification and clinical use without validation. Appropriate cautions for health data.

sub_elements.name: Ethical Review Details Including Conflicts
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: IRB approval documented with number and reliance agreements; human_subject_research: bioethics guidance, Community Advisory Board; no explicit conflicts of interest statement
sub_elements.quality_note: Ethical review thoroughly documented (IRB, bioethics, community engagement) but no conflicts of interest statement present. COI disclosure is standard for research datasets and should be included.
